name: SamurAI Shield :: Linux yum/dnf update (RHEL-like)
description: Input contract for playbooks/linux_yum_update_with_evidence.yml (repo: prfsouto/samurai-aap-playbooks). HOSTNAMES is auto-filled by SamurAI Shield from the governed asset and hidden from the operator form. IMPORTANT: enable 'Prompt on launch -> Extra variables' (ask_variables_on_launch) on the Job Template so the engine's governed HOSTNAMES (space-separated multi-host wave) overrides the survey's blank default instead of being discarded.

spec.question_description: Single host, IP, or space/comma-separated list. Filled automatically by SamurAI Shield from the selected asset — do not type it by hand.
Check lists available updates without changing packages. Apply installs them on the target.
all upgrades every package. security applies only security advisories (requires the repos to expose updateinfo.xml / the security plugin).
Comma-separated package names to exclude from the update (mapped to --exclude=).
true lets the playbook reboot the target after Apply, and only when a reboot is required (needs-restarting -r).
summary = counts only; package = one line per transaction (max 300); full = complete stdout/stderr.
Rolling batch size. 1 updates the wave strictly one host at a time.
Base directory on the target where the structured evidence files are written.
